name: com.oauth.huaweibranch.view.login.oneSDKLoginView
description: When the app requests a Huawei Branch sign-in, this CIBMall SDK page offers account login and the available Huawei or Facebook sign-in options. It returns the selected sign-in result to the app.
disableEffect: Disabling it blocks sign-in through the Huawei Branch SDK.
